description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy of various model configurations across different probing tasks, with the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy” ranging from 70 to 95 in linear increments, and the horizontal axis listing the task categories in the order: “embedding”, “1st layer”, “random layers”, “random layers +B₂”, “random layers +L₂”, “random layers +R₂”, “random layers +permute”, “random”, “random +B₂”, “random +L₂”, “random +R₂”, “random +permute”, and “unperturbed”. Each category is represented by a single bar, with the “embedding” and “1st layer” bars colored light blue, the “random layers” and its variants colored light green, the “random” and its variants colored light pink, and the “unperturbed” bar colored orange. The “embedding” bar reaches approximately 73, the “1st layer” bar reaches approximately 77, and the “random layers” bars all reach approximately 73. The “random” bars all reach approximately 72. The “unperturbed” bar reaches approximately 92. All bars are of uniform width and are not sorted; they are presented in the order specified on the x-axis. There are no visual annotations or emphasis on any specific bar.
